messages.subject: UseR! conference and GSoC
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

The UseR! (http://www.warwick.ac.uk/statsdept/user-2011/) organizers
just emailed me that the student projects are welcome to submit late
poster abstracts about their projects. There's no need to hurry right
now (neither does it really make sense to write an abstract before the
projects started), but please keep this in mind.

The UseR! conference is August 16th - 18th, so just after "pencils down"
date for the projects.

In addition, we'll probably can give a talk in the R development session
(I think that will be about more general aspects of GSoC for R).

Claudia

--
Claudia Beleites

messages.subject: Coding Start
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

official start of the coding period is today, so welcome to the "real" GSoC!

Here are the "homework done?" questions:

- students: are you in touch with you mentors?
- mentors: are the students in touch with you?
- is the technical side of communications working (IM/skype/whatever
communication)?

Please everyone drop John and me a short line that you are well
connected and working (and if not yet working due to exams etc. please
email, too).

Claudia
